functions.description: Parse PAN-OS SYSTEM log CSV fields
Derive _time from the millisecond-precision timestamp field
Extract user, src_ip, protocol from successful WebUI login messages

conf.regex: /User (?<user>\S+) logged in via WebUI from (?<src_ip>[\d.]+) using (?<protocol>\S+)/

functions.description: Extract user, src_ip, protocol, and reason from failed login attempt messages

conf.regex: /Failed login attempt for user (?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d.]+) using (?<protocol>\S+): (?<reason>.+)/

functions.description: Extract user and src_ip from repeated authentication failure messages

conf.regex: /Repeated authentication failures detected for user (?<user>\S+) from (?<src_ip>[\d.]+)/

functions.description: Classify action as success, failure, or info based on message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.indexOf('Failed')!==-1 || message.indexOf('failures')!==-1 || message.indexOf('failed')!==-1 || message.indexOf('down')!==-1 || message.indexOf('exceeded')!==-1 ? 'failure' : (message.indexOf('succeeded')!==-1 || message.indexOf('successfully')!==-1 || message.indexOf('successful')!==-1) ? 'success' : 'info'
